newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Pannon-Flax buys plant, begins work there.
newsitem.headline: Pannon-Flax buys plant, begins work there.

text.p: Hungarian textile producer Pannon-Flax Gyori Lenszovo Rt said on Monday it had bought the assets of the Lorinci spinning plant from Masterfil Rt and began operations there on November 1.

The spinning plant will operate as part of Pannon-Flax with an annual capacity of 1,000 tonnes, of which 50 to 60 percent will be used within the group while the rest will be sold, Pannon-Flax said in a statement in the official bourse gazette.
The plant is expected to produce goods worth 700 million forints, it said, and added that the plant's total workforce of 181 will remain employed.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Pannon-Flax shares stood at 455 forints, down five, at 1049 GMT.
